title: Mode bar is the floating pill
body: A rounded pill with text labels, floating at the bottom center. Picked over a full-width tab bar, an icon-only dock and a thin text strip.

title: Crescents' random function only gives values below 0.5
body: The hash copied from crescents never returns more than 0.5, so sizes, shades and scores only use half their range. The app's Canvas has the same bug; fix it when building the modes. Crescents itself has it too.

title: Table mode offers all four layouts
body: Spreadsheet, Cards, Split preview and Grouped, switchable from inside Table mode. Asked for by the user instead of picking one.

title: Canvas mode offers Staggered and Contact sheet
body: Both layouts, switchable inside Canvas. Scattered and Seed clusters were left out.

title: Focus mode offers all four layouts
body: Strip, Compass, Inspector and Dials, switchable inside Focus.

title: Built Canvas (2 layouts), Table (4) and Focus (4) into the app; not committed yet
One floating pill at the top holds all controls
body: Mode switch on the left; the pill grows to hold the mode's controls; in Focus it becomes back, trail and layout. Picked over a full-width toolbar and a path-style bar.

title: Pushed to github.com/romellogoodman/gps-website and deployed to gps.romellogoodman.com (Vercel, auto-deploys from main)
Added GPS to romellogoodman.com/software (commit 3ae7784, pushed by Romello)
GPS v1: three modes with switchable layouts, one top pill
body:
- **One floating pill at the top holds all controls.** The mode switch is on the left, and the pill grows to hold the mode's controls. In Focus it becomes back, the trail and the layout menu. This replaced the earlier bottom pill, which had been chosen over a tab bar, an icon dock and a text strip.
- **Canvas offers Staggered and Contact sheet.** Scattered and Seed clusters were left out.
- **Table offers all four layouts:** Spreadsheet, Cards, Split and Grouped.
- **Focus offers all four layouts:** Strip, Compass, Inspector and Dials.
